# First, identify the row for the Super Combined in 2009
super_combined_row = df[df['Race'].str.contains('Super Combined', na=False) & df['Season'].astype(str).str.contains('2009', na=False)]

# Get the date of that race
if not super_combined_row.empty:
    super_combined_date = super_combined_row['Date'].iloc[0]
    
    # Find all races in the 2009 season
    season_2009_races = df[df['Season'].astype(str).str.contains('2009', na=False)].copy()
    
    # Convert 'Date' to datetime for proper ordering
    season_2009_races['Date_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(season_2009_races['Date'], format='%d %b %Y')
    
    # Sort by date
    season_2009_races = season_2009_races.sort_values('Date_dt')
    
    # Find the index of the Super Combined race
    super_combined_idx = season_2009_races[season_2009_races['Date_dt'] == pd.to_datetime(super_combined_date, format='%d %b %Y')].index[0]
    
    # Get the previous race (if exists)
    if super_combined_idx > 0:
        previous_race = season_2009_races.iloc[super_combined_idx - 1]['Race']
        answer = previous_race
    else:
        answer = None
else:
    answer = None
